svg.data-line-read-by: Claude, 2026-10-31, on the page image: line 4 of the column counted from its top. Every column of the page begins on the same ruled line and no line above this one is blank, so the count is the same whether blank lines are counted or not; Charles Loder's leningrad-codex-tei at commit 15405046fe811d4e1064a7ebcd7cb92261ce72db numbers it line 4 too
svg.data-combined-source: UXLC 2.6, as copied into in/UXLC-39/: Exodus 19:23, atoms 5 to 10 of 20, the whole line; the verse has one cantillation, so the UXLC's text is the combined transcription; Ben has changed nothing in it
svg.data-adjacent-source: UXLC 2.6, as copied into in/UXLC-39/: the line above, line 3, is Exodus 19:22, atom 10 of 10, and Exodus 19:23, atoms 1 to 4 of 20; the line below, line 5, is Exodus 19:23, atoms 11 to 15 of 20; the lines' words as Charles Loder's leningrad-codex-tei at commit 15405046fe811d4e1064a7ebcd7cb92261ce72db has them, which the page image agrees with
svg.data-strokes-by: Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-10-31: each stroke's median placed by eye, in the order and direction Claude proposes the pen wrote it, then fitted by a script of Claude's onto the middle of its ink as one or a few cubic curves, with its widths and its cut ends' angles fitted to the ink
